design_philosophy: The 1TB step of Dell's mainstream Lunar Lake convertible — same chassis and panel as the base tier, doubled storage for people who keep media locally, sold at the same aggressive sale-price cadence as the rest of the line.
rating_notes: Same as entry 43 with +512GB storage (no factor movement). Inferred from CNET 16 Plus 2-in-1 anchor per SHARED-dell-2in1.md; no direct pro review of this line found.
